Bill.BriefDescription: Notifying home buyers of where information regarding registered sex offenders may be obtained.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to notifying home buyers of where informationregarding registered sex offenders may be obtained; adding a newsection to chapter 19.149 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 64.06RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.149 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A lender shall provide to the borrower, prior to the closing ofa residential mortgage loan, a disclosure statement in the followingformat that contains the following information: NOTICE TO THE BORROWERINFORMATION REGARDING REGISTERED SEX OFFENDERS IN YOUR AREA MAY BEOBTAINED FROM YOUR COUNTY SHERIFF. THIS NOTICE IS INTENDED ONLY TOINFORM YOU OF WHERE TO OBTAIN THIS INFORMATION AND IS NOT AN ASSERTIONOF THE PRESENCE, OR LACK THEREOF, OF REGISTERED SEX OFFENDERS IN YOURAREA.DATE . . . . . . . BORROWER . . . . . . . BORROWER . . . . . . . p. 1 HB 1056 (2) The disclosure statement required by subsection (1) of thissection does not create any legal duty on the part of the lender toprovide the borrower with information regarding the actual presence, orlack thereof, of registered sex offenders near the borrower's home.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 64.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In a sale of residential real property in which a real estatecontract as defined in RCW 61.30.010 is involved, or other type of salein which a lender as defined in RCW 19.149.010 is not utilized, theseller shall provide to the buyer, upon the signing of the real estatecontract or the transfer of the deed, whichever occurs first, adisclosure statement in the following format that contains thefollowing information: NOTICE TO THE BUYERINFORMATION REGARDING REGISTERED SEX OFFENDERS IN YOUR AREA MAY BEOBTAINED FROM YOUR COUNTY SHERIFF. THIS NOTICE IS INTENDED ONLY TOINFORM YOU OF WHERE TO OBTAIN THIS INFORMATION AND IS NOT AN ASSERTIONOF THE PRESENCE, OR LACK THEREOF, OF REGISTERED SEX OFFENDERS IN YOURAREA.DATE . . . . . . . BUYER . . . . . . . BUYER . . . . . . . (2) The disclosure statement required by subsection (1) of thissection does not create any legal duty on the part of the seller toprovide the buyer with information regarding the actual presence, orlack thereof, of registered sex offenders near the buyer's home.
This act applies prospectively only and notretroactively. It applies only to transactions occurring on or afterthe effective date of this act.
